HEADER: A ydych yn ymateb dros eich hun neu ar ran rhywun arall?
REPLY_SELF_INFO: Gallwch dal ofyn i aelod o'ch teulu neu unigolyn rydych yn ymddiried ynddynt i'ch helpu i ddeall neu ymateb.

NEED_HELP.TITLE: What if I need help replying?
NEED_HELP.INFO: You can ask a family member, friend or carer to help you. They can reply for you or help you to do it yourself. If you, or the person helping you, do not have regular access to the internet or do not feel confident using it, contact We Are Group. You may be eligible for a free appointment to help you access and use the online form. They cannot give you legal advice.

CONTACT_DETAILS.OPENING: Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm (except public holidays)
CONTACT_DETAILS.TEXT: Or text FORM to [text_no] and someone will call you back

NEED_HELP.BUREAU_HELP: If you need any other help, call the Jury Central Summoning Bureau on [tel_no]

REPLY_TP: Rwy'n ymateb ar ran rhywun arall
REPLY_TP_INFO: Gallwch ymateb ar ran rhywun arall os oes ganddynt anabledd neu nam sy'n golygu na allant ymateb dros eu hunain. Neu gallwch ymateb ar ran unigolyn sydd i ffwrdd, neu unigolyn sydd wedi marw.
